title: The Entire History of Japan in 10 Minutes | Animated History
description:
The ENTIRE History of Japan, from its prehistoric beginnings around 14,000 BCE to the fall of the Tokugawa shogunate in 1868. Discover how ancient Japan became a land of emperors, samurai, powerful clans and legendary warriors.

How did Japan begin? Who were the first people to inhabit the Japanese islands? How did the samurai rise to power, and what caused the end of the shogunate?

In Part One of The Entire History of Japan, we explore thousands of years of Japanese history, from the ancient Jōmon and Yayoi cultures to the rise of the imperial court, the age of the samurai, the Mongol invasions, the Sengoku period and the unification of Japan.

We follow legendary historical figures including Oda Nobunaga, Toyotomi Hideyoshi and Tokugawa Ieyasu, explore the remarkable Edo period, and witness the arrival of Commodore Matthew Perry's Black Ships in 1853.

Our journey ends in 1868 with the Meiji Restoration, a turning point that would transform Japan forever.

IN THIS DOCUMENTARY

Prehistoric Japan and the Jōmon period
The Yayoi period and the origins of early Japanese society
The rise of the Yamato state and Japan's emperors
The arrival of Buddhism and Prince Shōtoku
The Nara and Heian periods
The rise of the samurai and the first shogunate
The Mongol invasions of Japan
The Sengoku period and Japan's great warlords
Oda Nobunaga, Toyotomi Hideyoshi and Tokugawa Ieyasu
The Tokugawa shogunate and the Edo period
Commodore Perry and the opening of Japan
The Meiji Restoration of 1868

From ancient settlements and imperial palaces to samurai battles and the arrival of Western warships, this documentary tells the story of how Japan's history shaped the nation we know today.
